correctness.rationale: The cyclic path adjacency polynomial factors as z^(h-1)g_u(z)^(2h), with squarefree g_u; hence path-root sector lengths are h-1 at zero and 2h at nonzero roots. The square-grid Kronecker sum has zero eigenvalue only for equal roots. Direct truncated algebra yields J_h^h on length-h local factors and J_1 plus J_h^(h-2) on length-(h-1) factors, proving the full claimed zero-primary partition. Fitting decomposition establishes exact first-entry population formulas and boundary cases including n=2. Independent GF(2) square-grid rank comparisons passed 121 cases (n=2..18), plus 384 path-polynomial assertions and 68 local-algebra rank assertions; finite tests are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Finite square grids with zero boundary are canonical neighbor-additive dynamical systems. The known uniform nullity conceals a nontrivial 2-adic stratification of Jordan sizes, sharp extinction/periodic-entry delays, and explicit dimensions for the invertible sector. The theorem gives a natural, exact, all-side-length complete transient census, not an arbitrary slice or a mere reformulation of a known one-step rank.
